MARION HEIGHTS POLICE DEPARTMENT — INCIDENT REPORT
Report No.: MHPD-2024-02-2218
Reporting Officer: K. Vasquez #418
Date/Time: 02/28/2024 21:14
Location: 1107 Larkspur Lane, Marion Heights
Persons:
  R/P: Whitaker, Holly E. (DOB 03/19/1986)
  S-1: Whitaker, Derek J. (DOB 05/02/1983)
  Witnesses: L.W. (age 7), O.W. (age 4) — both present in living room

NARRATIVE:
Responded to 911 from R/P reporting "my husband hit me." On arrival, R/P answered front door visibly shaken with reddening on left cheek consistent with open-hand impact. R/P stated S-1 had returned home at approximately 20:30 "smelling of alcohol" and an argument began over a credit card statement.

R/P stated that during the argument S-1 "stepped toward me, raised his hand, and slapped me hard on the left side of my face." R/P stated this occurred in the living room with both children seated on the couch approximately 6 feet away.

S-1 was seated at the kitchen table when officers entered. S-1 was cooperative, admitted to consuming "three or four beers earlier in the evening." S-1 stated, "I lost my temper. I slapped her. I shouldn't have. It won't happen again." S-1 had no visible injuries.

Child L.W. was briefly interviewed in the presence of R/P (no Forensic Interviewer available at hour). L.W. stated, "Daddy hit Mommy on the face." L.W. did not appear to require medical attention.

EMERGENCY PROTECTIVE ORDER:
EPO issued at scene at 21:48 by on-call Judge Reyes. S-1 to vacate residence; no contact with R/P; supervised contact with children only.

S-1 transported to Westbrook County Jail pending DV booking. Charge: W.S.A. § 41-7-501 (Domestic Battery, Misdemeanor).

[STATUS UPDATE 04/02/2024: Charges dismissed per prosecutor (PT-2024-0314) after R/P declined to proceed. EPO converted to civil protective order in FL-2024-00871.]
